== mylib/rspec.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  prefix R
  category primitive
  provenance "xschem mylib/rspec.sym"
  xfp 94e920e3707c66cf
  vsym 6023306b1b245922

pin P inout 0 -30
pin M inout 0 30

param r 1k

impl spice spice
  format spice "{name} {pins} rmod r={r}"
  format spectre "{name} ( {pins} ) rmod r={r}"

line 0 -30 0 30
  layer 4

== sky130_fd_pr/nfet_01v8.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso sky130_fd_pr/nfet_01v8"
  vibox -40 -40 40 40
  vsym 25a1f83230558b23

pin D inout 0 -40
  vplabel 0 0 R0 centerLeft stick 10000
pin G in -40 0
  vplabel 0 0 R0 centerLeft stick 10000
pin S inout 0 40
  vplabel 0 0 R0 centerLeft stick 10000
pin B inout 40 0
  vplabel 0 0 R0 centerLeft stick 10000

param model sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8
  kind string
  doc Model
param w 1
  kind string
param l 1
  kind string
param nf 1
  kind string
param m 1
  kind string

impl spice spice
  format spectre "{name} ({D} {G} {S} {B}) {model}"

rect -20 -20 20 20

stext 0 -30 R0 {name}
  size 1
  vlabel annotate drawing7 lowerLeft stick IL cdsName() {name}
